name: Category list
description: Every menu category with its description.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/category-list", name: "Category list", kind: Kind.categoryNav,
  description: "Every menu category with its description.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [ForEach(items: options.menu.categories, as: "c", child: Box(padding: Space.md, radius: Radius.md, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), child: Column(gap: Space.xs, children: [Text(child: c.name, weight: FontWeight.semibold), If(condition: c.description, then: Text(child: c.description, size: FontSize.sm, color: Color.textMuted))])))])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "menu", type: Menu, required: true)],
)
